title: Find the Shortest Superstring II
summary: Given two strings, s1 and s2, find the shortest string that includes both as substrings.
statement: Given two strings, s1 and s2, find the shortest string that includes both as substrings. Any valid shortest string is acceptable if multiple exist.
constraints: Return a shortest string containing both inputs as substrings.
If one input contains the other, return the containing string.
For deterministic feedback, return the lexicographically smallest among equally short answers.
known_wrong_solutions:
def shortest_two_string_superstring(s1,s2):
    if s1 in s2:return s2
    if s2 in s1:return s1
    candidates=[]
    for left,right in ((s1,s2),(s2,s1)):
        overlap=min(len(left),len(right))
        while overlap and not left.endswith(right[:overlap]):overlap-=1
        candidates.append(left+right[overlap:])
    return candidates[0]
def shortest_two_string_superstring(s1,s2):
    if s1 in s2:return s2
    if s2 in s1:return s1+s2
    candidates=[]
    for left,right in ((s1,s2),(s2,s1)):
        overlap=min(len(left),len(right))
        while overlap and not left.endswith(right[:overlap]):overlap-=1
        candidates.append(left+right[overlap:])
    return min(candidates,key=lambda text:(len(text),text))
hints: With two strings, an optimal answer either is the containing string or uses the largest suffix-prefix overlap in one of two orientations.
Build both maximal-overlap concatenations, then choose by length and lexicographic order.
Handle containment; for each ordering decrease overlap until suffix equals prefix; minimize (length,string).
Any superstring with neither input contained must place one before the other, and increasing their overlap never increases length, so the two maximal orientations exhaust all optima.
